change.summary: Maintain a derived, non-runtime combat inventory with Stage 3.5A boss-reward weapons, Stage 3.5B boss combat, and Stage 3.5C exact armor, Curios, durability and defensive mitigation evidence plus registration factories, installed configuration evidence and numeric reference tables.

before.reason: Combat evidence was distributed across registry partitions and owning sources.

after.model: Original -> Modifiers -> JEM tweaks -> Effective -> Acquisition -> Assessment

modifiers.notes: The generated view is evidence only. Unknown values stay unresolved and warnings never auto-balance gameplay.

rationale.purpose: Make every combat candidate findable and every claimed power expression traceable without duplicating runtime ownership or fabricating missing values.
rationale.decision_source: User-supplied CODEX TASK — JEM Universal Power Balance System

introduced.summary: Created the permanent power-system documentation and source-derived power views without changing production gameplay.

history.summary: Inventoried combat candidates, documented shared formulas, added 16 reference scenarios and recorded the unresolved beam candidate set.

Cleaned asset/model false positives from combat items; linked all 61 bosses and 106 Iron's Spells IDs to exact-version owner classes; recorded channel evidence, safe spell formulas, item/armor/accessory signals, ally owner evidence and five source-verified audit findings without changing runtime balance.

Restored all 36 boss-reward weapon IDs, added source-backed active Epic Fight/Nightfall capabilities, kept absent Better Combat profiles inactive, traced exact item attributes/durability/cooldowns where provable and generated spell, boss, weapon and mitigation tables without changing runtime balance.

Resolved DeferredRegister suppliers through their real JVM bootstrap method handles, followed bounded delegated attack/effect classes, linked installed TOML values, exposed exact basic weapon constructors and tiers, separated offensive methods from wear/support paths, and generated per-object durability, power-ladder and named-blocker records. Remaining dynamic formulas stay explicitly unresolved; runtime combat values are unchanged.

Added strict set-equal deep profiles for all 36 reward-category weapons, closed exact ordinary damage, numeric special branches, cooldown and durability evidence where static sources permit, replaced their generic blockers with exact phase/collision/runtime boundaries, and added conditional World Tier and cooldown-window calculations without changing gameplay.

Recovered exact native attributes and base melee for the 61-boss inventory, removed inbound hurt handlers from the offensive denominator, attached source-proven percent-health/config formulas, and generated absolute Tier/player/hosted/Raid melee plus reference-mitigation rows without changing gameplay.

Resolved 125 exact armor material profiles, 24 complete comparable sets, 22 Curios slot contracts, 10 accessory attribute containers and 1,080 defensive outcomes; separated inherited wear from eight exact Cataclysm unbreakable armor overrides without changing gameplay.

notes: No Java, Mixin, config, datapack, installed JAR or runtime behavior is changed.
unresolved: For the 36 boss rewards, remaining gaps are named capability precedence, external/custom animation phases, projectile overlap, iframe acceptance and branched entity scheduling; 31 require controlled runtime observation that was not authorized in Stage 3.5A.
For bosses, 133 special formulas, 61 AI/frequency fields and 5 base-melee fields remain named blockers; trigger ticks alone are not treated as accepted-hit frequency or sustained DPS.
For defenses, 94 records still lack exact material/dynamic attributes and 15 grouped sets lack four exact piece totals; only the Annihilator stem has a confirmed explicit full-set gate.

For accessories and durability, unresolved Curios capabilities, runtime NBT and 310 consumption profiles remain named blockers; eight Cataclysm armor overrides are separately proven explicitly unbreakable.

Outside the 36-weapon scope, branched projectile/goal/effect formulas, runtime ItemStack attributes, target mitigation, complete Epic Fight/Nightfall attack phases and the exact reported beam ItemStack remain explicitly unresolved with per-field named blockers.
Stage 3 calculates only fully traceable layers; runtime balance changes remain reserved for later approved phases.
